meta.name: git-master
meta.description: MUST USE whenever a task needs a commit or git-history investigation. Covers atomic commits, staging, commit-message style, rebase, squash, fixup/autosquash, blame, bisect, reflog, git log -S/-G, and questions like who wrote this or when was this added. Do not use for ordinary code edits unless the user asks for git work.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 管理 Git 提交与历史，自动生成规范提交
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要规范提交或排查 Git 历史
copy.tagline_en: Manage Git commits and history with automated commit messages
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to make clean commits or investigate Git history

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能帮你做 Git 相关操作：提交、暂存、改写历史、查找代码变更来源等。它不会自动干预普通代码编辑，只在你明确要求 Git 任务时行动。
howto.when: 当你要求与 Git 历史或提交相关的操作时触发，例如“提交更改”、“查看谁改了这段代码”、“rebase 分支”等。

say.text: 帮我查一下这段代码是谁改的？
请将我的本地更改组织成原子提交。
say.note: 触发提交模式，Claude 会分组暂存并提交。

say.text: rebase 当前分支到 main，并自动 squash fixup 提交。
say.note: 触发 rebase 模式，Claude 会谨慎操作。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude becomes a Git expert: it can perform atomic commits, staging, rebase, squash, fixup, blame, bisect, reflog, and answer who wrote what and when. It only acts when you explicitly ask for Git tasks, not during ordinary code edits.
howto.when_en: Triggered whenever you ask for Git-related operations: commit, history investigation, rebase, etc. Not used for regular code editing unless Git work is requested.

say_en.text: Show me who last changed this line of code.
say_en.note: Triggers history mode using blame or git log.

say_en.text: Stage my local changes and commit them atomically.
say_en.note: Triggers commit mode with careful grouping.

say_en.text: Rebase this branch onto main and autosquash fixups.
say_en.note: Triggers rebase mode with safety checks.
